subject: Joint webinar request: Quantiva Labs customer spotlight
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@quantivalabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint webinar request: Quantiva Labs customer spotlight

Hi Daniel,

Hope you’re doing well — congrats again on the rollout of Quantiva’s real-time inference pipeline. The story you and the team have built with Redwood (low-latency scoring at scale + cost controls) would make a great customer spotlight for our webinar series.

Would Quantiva be open to a short joint webinar (30–40 minutes) where a Quantiva engineering/product lead and a Redwood engineer do a 20–25 minute walkthrough and follow with a 10–15 minute Q&A? We’ll handle speaker coordination, promotion, and provide a short recording release so your team can reuse the clip.

Draft outline attached (webinar_outline.pdf) and a speaker-bio template (speaker_bio_template.docx). High-level details:
- Proposed window: week of Apr 27–May 8 (flexible)
- Format: 25 min conversation/demo + 10–15 min audience Q&A
- Audience: platform engineers, ML infra leads, and product managers (approx. 1.5k registrants expected)

Do you have a preferred presenter at Quantiva? If you’re interested I can send a proposed date/time (Calendly link below) and the recording/reuse language.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/rishi-1/30min

Thanks — excited about the possibility.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: webinar_outline.pdf, speaker_bio_template.docx

Rishi — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words. We’d be interested — this aligns well with our GTM push on real-time inference.

Quick questions:
- Do you have a target date in that window?
- Is there a requirement for Legal/Proc (we usually run marketing collabs through legal for an NDA/comms approval)

I’ve cc’d Sana (Quantiva marketing) who will be the day-to-day for approvals and logistics. I’m likely to join the session alongside our ML infra lead (we’ll confirm the speaker).

Best,
Daniel
VP, Engineering
Quantiva Labs

Thanks Daniel — and hi Sana.

Proposed session slot: Tuesday, Apr 28 at 10:00 AM PT (30–35 minute session: 20–25 min conversation + 10 Q&A). If that doesn’t work we can do Thu, Apr 30 or any day the following week.

Recording/use: we ask for a short recording release so Redwood’s marketing can share a trimmed clip and quote in a follow-up case study. I’ve attached a one-paragraph release we typically use and a DocuSign link we can send if Legal prefers (I’ll include the link when you’re ready).

Logistics we’d need from your side:
- Confirm primary speaker(s) (title + short bio)
- Logo and two-sentence customer quote (if you’re comfortable — we can draft it and share for approval)
- Any non-negotiable legal language (Sana, I saw you’re cc’d — happy to work with your team)

I’ll have Monica coordinate slide review and run-of-show. If helpful, here’s my Calendly again: https://calendly.com/rishi-1/30min

Thanks,
Rishi
